title: How to Start a UK Limited Company from Pakistan: Companies House, HMRC and Tax
description: Guide for Pakistani entrepreneurs forming a UK Ltd company: Companies House registration, registered office, director ID verification, corporation tax and VAT.
lead: Guide for Pakistani entrepreneurs forming a UK Ltd company: Companies House registration, registered office, director ID verification, corporation tax and VAT.
body:
A UK private limited company (Ltd) is one of the fastest ways to build credibility for international trade, e-commerce, consultancy and digital services. Non-residents can usually incorporate and act as directors and shareholders, but there are tax and compliance obligations that must be handled correctly.

What you need

  • A unique company name and suitable SIC codes
  • A UK registered office address
  • Director and shareholder details, including passport and residential address
  • Identity verification for directors and people with significant control
  • A Memorandum and Articles of Association

Incorporation steps

  1. Choose the name and check availability.
  2. File the application with Companies House.
  3. Receive the certificate of incorporation, often within a short time.
  4. Register for Corporation Tax with HMRC.
  5. Register for VAT when required, for example above the turnover threshold (currently £90,000) or voluntarily.
  6. Open a business bank account or payment account.

UK tax snapshot

  • Corporation tax: 25 percent main rate, with 19 percent for small profits up to £50,000 and marginal relief in between
  • VAT: 20 percent standard rate
  • Annual filings: confirmation statement, annual accounts and corporation tax return (CT600)

Residency matters

A company incorporated in the UK is treated as UK tax resident. If the directors live in Pakistan, you must also consider Pakistani tax residency, permanent establishment risk and double-tax-treaty relief. Take advice before you start trading.
